title: er, ir and ur
rule: The letters er, ir and ur all say the same sound, /er/. You have to remember which spelling each word uses.
trickText: Say the word slowly. Hear the /er/ sound. Then picture the word: does it use er, ir, or ur? The more you read these words, the easier it gets.
say: Today's case: er, ir and ur. They all make the same sound. The trick is to remember which spelling each word uses. Say the word, then choose.

activities.instruction: Listen to the word. Choose er, ir, or ur.

items.why: The /er/ sound in fern is spelled er: fern.
The /er/ sound in her is spelled er: her.
The /er/ sound in germ is spelled er: germ.
The /er/ sound in bird is spelled ir: bird.
The /er/ sound in girl is spelled ir: girl.
The /er/ sound in shirt is spelled ir: shirt.
The /er/ sound in surf is spelled ur: surf.
The /er/ sound in turn is spelled ur: turn.
The /er/ sound in burn is spelled ur: burn.
The /er/ sound in nurse is spelled ur: nurse.
